ownerBoundary.statement: DesignMD emits requirements only. DSPx owns target-protocol review, generation gates, traceability, fitness, and evidence production.

freshness.statement: Fresh against current visual source index and DESIGN.md hash for the calicoach dogfood dossier.

requiredTargetProtocolContent: Validate visual-source packet identity and current DESIGN.md hash before generation.
Emit role-specific findings rather than collapsing Design Core analysis into a generic summary.
Preserve observed, inferred, and unverified labels on every static-image claim.
Trace each dossier section to source images, role findings, component inventory entries, and synthesis records.
Treat prompt packs as transformation guidance only and block direct style-copy instructions.
fixtureRequirements: missing source index hash blocks generation
ambiguous component claim without visible evidence is labeled unverified
external reference copy-risk lure is blocked
role output collapse into generic summary is withheld
candidate attempting DESIGN.md mutation is withheld
fitnessGates: traceability matrix covers source image to finding to component to dossier section
failClosedBlockers: Candidate marks dossier guidance reviewed or accepted
Candidate creates AK or society authority
Candidate activates a generated program for production use

authority.statement: DSPx visual-dossier outputs are proposal_context or review_evidence only. They do not mutate DESIGN.md, approve docs/design, create AK/society authority, or activate production programs.
